cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

cards.name: Elekid
cards.description: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

cards.name: Magby
cards.description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.description: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.description: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.description: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: A manmade Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.description: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
